description: 충청남도 계룡시_도로명주소 정보 API [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 충청남도 계룡시. 충청남도 계룡시의 '도로명주소 정보 API' 데이터는 관내의 모든 시설물 및 토지에 대한 도로명 주소와 관련된 상세 정보 및 변동 이력을 실시간으로 제공하는 공간 정보 서비스입니다. Coverage: 충청남도 계룡시. The portal files it under the publisher 충청남도 계룡시. Its tags are 도로명 주소, 시설물, 기존 주소, 도로명 주소 고시 일, 도로명 고시 일. It offers 1 resource(s) in json. The portal shows 2025-11-24 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
